entries.en: to mock; to make fun of; to deride
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏 T99（污损难辨），L（burlar＝嘲弄）与 H（弄滚）互证清晰，仅源件可辨性受限而降级。

entries.zh: 戏弄而使人陷入迷惘、蒙受亏损（滚、有损：嘲弄致有伤损）
entries.en: to mock and lead someone into perplexity (a labyrinth); to mock to his harm
entries.notes: L 栏 laberynto/la burla 与 R 栏 dun/sun 均存疑，取『戏弄致陷迷惘受损』一读。

entries.zh: 咧齿讥笑，嗤笑（齿笑：露齿而笑以嘲人）
entries.en: to laugh at; to sneer at; to mock openly (lit. mock with the teeth)
entries.notes: dtes. 按缩写惯例展开为 dientes（burlar de dientes），M 栏 duto/dientes 存疑。

entries.en: to mock coarsely; to jest rudely
to mock rudely; to jeer wildly

entries.zh: 恶意戏弄，恶劣嘲弄（歹滚）
entries.en: to mock maliciously; to make fun of spitefully
entries.notes: R 栏首音节 páy/tày 声母 t/f 存疑，释义依 H（歹滚＝恶意戏弄）。

entries.zh: 粗野轻贱地作弄，肆意贬嘲（野贱）
entries.en: to mock rudely and contemptuously; to scorn with mockery
entries.notes: 缩写 pesadam.te 按惯例展开为 pesadamente，释义随之推断。

entries.zh: 持文书、条款示人而加以嘲弄（跳弄）
entries.en: to mock someone by showing him something, papers/documents or terms
entries.notes: pliegos/plumas 存疑，取 pliegos（文书、条款），释义落在马尼拉贸易文书语境。

entries.en: she-ass; female donkey
entries.notes: L 栏 Burra/Buxa 与 R 栏 mùn/mǔ 均存疑，据 H（驴母）定为母驴。

entries.en: to seek; to look for; to search
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏含 T99（污损难辨），L/H（buscar＝尋）互证清晰，仅源件可辨性不足。

entries.en: to ponder; to think over; to reflect (lit. seek while thinking)
entries.notes: R 栏含 T99 且 sū/sy 存疑，释义据 H（尋思）与 L（buscar pensando）推定。

entries.zh: 寻看，边看边找（寻省：省视而求）
entries.en: to look about for; to search by inspecting
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏含 T99，据 H（尋省）与 L（buscar mirando）释作边看边找。

entries.en: to seek and find
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏含 T99，M 栏 hallar solo/hallarlo so 存疑，释义据 H（尋見）。

entries.en: to seek and not find; to search in vain
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏含 T99，据 H（尋不見）与 L（buscar y no hallar）释义。

entries.zh: 寻找剩余之物（后手：事后所余、剩下的部分）
entries.en: to look for what remains; to seek the leftover or balance
entries.notes: R 栏两处 T99；『后手』取马尼拉贸易语境『事后所余』义对应 lo que sobra，含推断。

entries.zh: 寻缝，找隙；本义寻物之裂缝，转指寻衅挑剔、找岔子
entries.en: to look for a crack or seam; to pick faults, find an opening
entries.notes: L 栏西语词头两处缺损（ro[残]o del [残]esa）无法复原，释义依 H/M（尋縫）并含转义。

entries.en: to inquire; to investigate so as to verify
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 按惯例展开为 por（buscar por certificarse＝查问求证）。

entries.zh: 查着，查到（查问而有所得）
entries.en: to find out by inquiry; to hit upon in searching
to rummage; to search through by turning things over
entries.notes: L 栏 Trasegar/Trasagar 拼写存疑，取 trasegar『翻检』义。

entries.en: to search out; to rummage through and seek
entries.notes: M/R 声调栏含 T99，释义据 H（搜尋）与 L（buscar trasegar）。
